additional_info.body:
Dear Michael,
I hope you are doing well.
Could you please elaborate on the issue you are facing? We are currently unable to clearly identify or reproduce the problem as described.
If the issue is related to the outlets not functioning, please note that we have already checked and confirmed that all outlets are now working properly. There was previously a loss of communication between the PLC and the SECC, which caused the charger outlets to go out of order. However, after re-establishing the connection, all charger outlets are functioning normally and are in a healthy state.
